symptom: The first frozen snapshot hash differed after JSON serialization because one runtime emitted integral floats as integers.
root_cause: Canonical hashing did not normalize semantically equivalent numeric representations before SHA-256.
early_signals: Snapshot fields included percentage values represented as 100.0 in Python
JSON serialization from JavaScript emitted the same values as 100
human_cost: No operator troubleshooting required; first fidelity CI run failed and triggered autonomous recovery.
prevention_rule: Canonicalize integral floats to integers recursively before hashing cross-runtime JSON/YAML artifacts.
automated_detection: Regression test asserts sha256({value:100}) equals sha256({value:100.0}).
